projects.title: Handloom House — Full-Stack E-commerce Platform
projects.subtitle: Production-ready MERN e-commerce application developed for a paying client.
projects.description: A production-ready MERN e-commerce application developed for a paying client, supporting product catalog management, dynamic filtering, cart operations, order management, and online payments.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Local textile artisans and handloom weavers lacked an accessible direct-to-consumer digital commerce channel. Their existing manual order flow suffered from inconsistent inventory tracking, slow customer communication, and no secure digital payment mechanism.
objectives: Support an interactive catalog displaying 100+ artisan textile and garment products.
Build 15+ secure REST APIs with high data integrity and sub-100ms response targets.
Integrate Razorpay payment gateway with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
Provide a route-protected administrative dashboard for orders, dispatch status, and product updates.
caseStudy.solutionOverview: Engineered a comprehensive MERN platform with rich client-side browsing, dynamic fabric and price filters, real-time cart persistence, automated Razorpay modal payments, and an admin command center for order lifecycle processing.
caseStudy.technicalArchitecture: A decoupled React SPA communicates with an Express.js server connected to MongoDB. Incoming requests pass through JWT verification, body sanitization, and structured route controllers. Payment webhooks trigger transactional database updates only after cryptographically validating the SHA256 digest.
keyDecisions: Implemented cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 verification directly on the server to prevent forged payment callbacks.
Utilized compound indexes in MongoDB for instantaneous category and price range query execution across 100+ items.
Engineered route-protected admin middleware separating public shoppers from back-office fulfillment operations.
caseStudy.challengesAndSolutions:
Challenge: Managing payment synchronization when shoppers closed the browser window before the confirmation redirect.
Solution: Implemented server-side payment capture verification webhooks with idempotent database states, preventing double charging or lost orders.
verifiedFeatures: Support for a catalog of 100+ products
futureImprovements: Automated WhatsApp shipping notifications for buyers upon dispatch
Multi-currency checkout for international handloom collectors
Automated stock depletion warning alerts for store administrators

projects.title: Play4Glory — Esports Tournament Management Platform
projects.subtitle: Full-stack esports platform for tournament brackets, digital wallets, and match progression.
projects.description: A full-stack esports platform designed to manage tournaments, teams, match progression, digital wallet operations, and tournament scoring.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Grassroots esports organizers rely on chaotic messaging apps and spreadsheets, causing disputed match outcomes, delayed bracket advancement, and manual payment calculation errors.
objectives: Automate 64-team single-elimination tournament bracket generation with recursive match trees.
Provide a dual-portal architecture with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for players and referees.
Implement a digital wallet with audited ledger transactions, deposit verification, and administrative withdrawal approvals.
caseStudy.solutionOverview: Architected an end-to-end tournament hub where teams register, stake entry fees via integrated wallets, follow dynamic bracket progression, submit match results with screenshot attachments, and view live MVP leaderboards.
caseStudy.technicalArchitecture: Express.js backend utilizing recursive tree algorithms for bracket generation and node traversal. MongoDB schema with atomic balance operations for digital wallets. React frontend rendering interactive tournament brackets with responsive pan/zoom visualization.
keyDecisions: Employed recursive tree traversal logic to handle 64-team seedings, automatic bye allocations, and round advancement.
Created double-entry ledger mechanics for digital wallets, ensuring every credit and debit is immutable and traceable.
Structured strict RBAC middleware preventing unauthorized match score overrides.
caseStudy.challengesAndSolutions:
Challenge: Preventing score disputes and duplicate submissions from competing team captains.
Solution: Built a dispute-lock state requiring mutual confirmation or human admin review with uploaded screenshot proof.
futureImprovements: Automated Discord bot webhook integration for instant match lobby announcements
Live spectator bracket widget for Twitch and YouTube live streaming
Team captain voice chat lobby integration

projects.title: Pathlytic AI — AI-Powered Learning and Career Roadmaps
projects.subtitle: AI-powered mentoring platform that generates personalized learning roadmaps based on career goals.
projects.description: An AI-powered mentoring platform that generates personalized learning roadmaps based on career goals, academic background, skill confidence, and deadlines.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Students and early-career developers struggle with fragmented learning resources and tutorial hell, lacking an objective, timeline-aware roadmap tailored to their actual baseline skills and target job roles.
objectives: Build an intelligent multi-step onboarding wizard gathering user aspirations, hours per week, and skill confidence.
Integrate Google Gemini API with schema enforcement to synthesize actionable week-by-week roadmaps.
Track student progress with milestone checklists, gamified experience points (XP), and Power BI embedded analytics.
caseStudy.solutionOverview: Pathlytic AI analyzes student inputs and produces structured, adaptive weekly milestones with curated project challenges, knowledge assessments, and progress velocity tracking.
caseStudy.technicalArchitecture: Express backend communicating with the @google/genai SDK, passing rigorous JSON schema constraints to guarantee valid roadmap structures. MongoDB stores roadmap graphs and user progress states. Power BI reports deliver comprehensive study pace analytics.
keyDecisions: Enforced structured JSON responses from Gemini to eliminate parsing inconsistencies and avoid hallucinations.
Introduced an XP and milestone progression model to increase learner motivation and retention.
Integrated Power BI visual dashboards for deep insights into study duration and topic completion trends.
caseStudy.challengesAndSolutions:
Challenge: Large prompt token overhead when generating detailed 12-week comprehensive curriculums.
Solution: Architected modular generational chunking, synthesizing foundational roadmap stages immediately and streaming extended milestones progressively.
futureImprovements: AI resume analyzer that checks curriculum milestones against real-time job openings
Peer study pods with shared sprint challenges and leaderboards
